parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number, starting from 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: PolicyAction
parameters.description: The policy action. Single-value exact match.

parameters.name: SrcFileName
parameters.description: The original file name. Fuzzy match.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: SubChannelType
parameters.description: The secondary channel ID in the format of `PrimaryChannelID.SubChannelID`. Separate multiple values with commas.
